title: ProVADA steers a protein generator to adapt proteins to non-native biological contexts
summary: ProVADA steered a pretrained protein generator to produce active, drug-inhibitable cytosolic renin and deimmunized two murine antibody fragments while retaining antigen recognition. ESCAPE-seq measured reduced HLA-I peptide binding, and redesigned FMC63 variants retained CAR-T-cell killing. This summary is limited to the abstract of the October 18, 2026 version 2 preprint; the initial preprint dates to July 17, 2025.
ai_technology: ProVADA (Mixture-Adaptation Directed Annealing sampler steering a pretrained protein generator)

evidence.tested: Renin activity/inhibitor response, antibody antigen recognition and HLA-I peptide binding, and FMC63 CAR-T-cell killing, as reported in the version 2 abstract.
evidence.unknown: Only the abstract, PMC version header and original-server corresponding-institution metadata were assessed; full author-affiliation list and full paper were not reviewed. Preserve ID.
evidence.ai_role: A pretrained protein generator, steered by ProVADA's annealing sampler toward externally defined properties while preserving functional constraints.
